edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the 'from' address when transfer is called.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as owner to _approve from approve.
deliver() reads msg.sender as the sender whose reflections are burned.
_owner stored by owner() originated from msg.sender at deployment.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender directly.
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender, so the caller identity controls ownership restoration.
unlock() requires now > _lockTime, a block.timestamp dependency governing access.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the Uniswap router.
lock() computes _lockTime from block.timestamp, making lock duration time dependent.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call that transfers control outside the contract.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router address and pair path from state.
An external Uniswap router call can re-enter the token transfer entry point before state settles.
lock() writes _lockTime, the timestamp used by unlock() access checks.
lock() stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
lock() derives the unlock time from block.timestamp via now + time.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner, mutating privileged state.
unlock() reads _previousOwner for the caller check and reassignment.
constructor credits _rOwned[_msgSender()] with the whole reflection supply.
constructor initializes _rTotal with reflection supply arithmetic.
constructor stores the immutable Uniswap V2 router.
constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair.
constructor populates the fee-exclusion mapping for owner, contract and dev.
constructor executes the unchecked MAX modulo reflection supply computation.
transfer() delegates to the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve() calls _approve to write the allowance.
_transfer validates inputs then dispatches to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads the isBlacklisted mapping to block senders.
_transfer compares amount against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer computes heldTokens + amount against _maxWalletToken.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after the transfer variant.
_tokenTransfer selects _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_transferStandard computes token values via _getTValues.
_transferStandard computes reflection values via _getRValues.
_transferStandard credits the dev fee.
_transferStandard credits the burn fee.
_transferStandard reflects the fee into _rTotal.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount and adds rTransferAmount to _rOwned.
_transferStandard interacts with _tOwned bookkeeping for excluded accounts.
_takeDevFee increases _rOwned of the dev address.
_takeDevFee routes fee reflections to _devAddress.
_takeBurnFee increases _rOwned of the burn address.
_takeBurnFee routes fee reflections to _burnAddress.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_getTValues depends on the current reflection rate.
_getRValues receives the rate used for reflection conversion.
_getRate obtains supply figures from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal as the token supply base.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply base.
_getCurrentSupply iterates the exclusion mapping and array.
deliver() subtracts rAmount from the caller's _rOwned balance.
deliver() reduces _rTotal by rAmount.
deliver() increases _tFeeTotal by tAmount.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate from _getRate.
reflectionFromToken derives fee values via _getTValues.
reflectionFromToken derives reflection values via _getRValues.
excludeFromReward is onlyOwner and writes the exclusion mapping.
includeInReward is onlyOwner and clears the exclusion mapping.
setIsBlacklisted is onlyOwner and writes the blacklist mapping.
setMaxTxPercent is onlyOwner and recomputes _maxTxAmount by mul/div.
setMaxWalletPercent is onlyOwner and recomputes _maxWalletToken by mul/div.
setTaxFeePercent is onlyOwner and writes _taxFee.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _taxFee.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _devFee.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _burnFee.
restoreAllFee restores cached fee values.
excludeFromFee is onlyOwner and sets the fee-exclusion flag.
includeInFee is onlyOwner and clears the fee-exclusion flag.
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and zeroes _owner.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and overwrites _owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
recipient parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into transfer() and later arithmetic fee math.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom().
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom().
amount parameter flows into transferFrom() allowance subtraction.
tAmount parameter flows into deliver() reflection arithmetic.
holder parameter flows into the owner-only blacklist write.
exempt parameter flows into the owner-only blacklist write.
maxTxPercent parameter flows into the multiply/divide limit recomputation.
time parameter flows into the now + time lock computation.
local tAmount is used inside _getTValues fee math.
local rAmount is produced by _getRValues reflection math.
local currentRate holds the value returned by _getRate.
local tTransferAmount is written to recipient balances in _transferStandard.
